request: Compare Bella with86c500c and current OldScanner on this computer and EDIT; explain sanitizers and review simplifications.

scope.bella: Finished PMR/MDB database stages only. No Bella full scanner, remaining header readers, final formatter or app cutover.
scope.specimens: Managed originals, application-supplied files, copies/archives and authored controls are separately identified. Full roots include leftover test media trees.

sourceAndFolderStamps.baseline: Current full scan inputStampsBefore; checked again after historical full scan
sourceAndFolderStamps.limits: Database contents are SHA-256 checked. Media files and folders are checked by native size, modification time, device, inode and directory status; media payloads were not hashed. This cannot exclude an undetectable same-stamp media edit.

fullHistoricalVsCurrent.scope: Historical 86c500ca6bf9cc93529017979d0f1b3ddac856be full MediaScanner scan versus current OldScanner full scan, including actual physical discovery/header reads/matching. This is separate from the Bella database-stage comparison. No Bella full scanner has been run or integrated.
rules: Physical path is the comparison key; all path-set differences and row-field differences are retained.
Compare exact displayed/stored text. No case, punctuation, URI, codec, unknown-marker or ID normalization is applied.
Nineteen same-named CSV columns are compared directly. Codec->Compression and MobId->FileMobId are explicit renames.
Current Source Path is compared to historical JSON sourceFilePath, not historical CSV Source Filename.

Current No Database and No Reference booleans are compared to the historical dbStatus meanings; historical unreadable versus absent cannot be reconstructed from the current CSV boolean alone, but no historical unreadable rows occur here.
Current OmfScan is compared to historical JSON omfEra.
KelpieId is excluded only because the historical API has no such per-scan identity; every current value is retained separately.
Historical Source Filename is an additional field without an exact current returned-field counterpart. All nonempty values are retained with an explicit empty default for all other physical paths.

Current JSON retains property fingerprints rather than decoded property values. This report therefore proves equality/differences of the 25 comparable current CSV fields, not every raw historical/internal property.
No performance conclusion is drawn: historical and current feature sets and measurements differ, and filesystem cache was uncontrolled.

Six managed MDBs agree on2435 file IDs, physical lengths, original rate pairs and visible resolutions;200 applicable recorded numbering modes agree.

A historical extra managed master is outside active catalogues; one historical Bin contribution comes from an inactive same-ID object.
Bella retains16-bit RGBA precision for18 managed records with blank historical labels, and distinguishes four S2.14-fixed from four Float32 records labeled alike historically.
48 archive category differences across two copies follow empty ATTR lists: Bella RenderedEffects versus historical/current Unknown, not48 live damaged specimens.
All2413 database-listed current physical rows join Bella local MDB full IDs and direct masters;2412 also join exact PMR names/IDs. The remaining copy.mxf uses MDB/header identity.
All listed final current CSV Projects agree with Bella MDB, including71 physical rows whose current MDB-only Project was blank.
1435 current NoDatabase physical rows require remaining media/header paths Bella has not implemented.

Reference coverage differs on all15 valid MDBs: Bella complete versus current projection false for proven nonphysical source owners. Current has0NoReference rows. The historical copy.mxf NoReference row has a positive MDB/header ID match, so it is not a genuinely unreferenced specimen validating the negative boundary.
